entities.name: 1,4-Benzoquinone
observations: At 10 μmol/L for 24 hours, induced autophagy-associated changes in human HL-60 cells; higher concentrations caused dose-dependent viability loss.

entities.name: HL-60
observations: Human promyelocytic leukemia cells used to study 1,4-benzoquinone-induced autophagy and ROS involvement.

entities.name: PMID:27514409
observations: The 2016 study reported increased acidic autophagic vesicles, LC3-II/LC3-I, and Beclin-1 after 1,4-benzoquinone exposure in HL-60 cells.
N-acetylcysteine pretreatment reduced the benzoquinone-associated autophagy markers, supporting partial ROS mediation; direct ROS measurement was not clearly documented in the available abstract.

entities.name: PMID:29567065
observations: A 2018 follow-up reported PINK1/Parkin-mediated protective mitophagy in HL-60 cells exposed to 1,4-benzoquinone, with ROS and mitochondrial/autophagy measurements.
